FPH-01: Basic phrase query — exact sequence Query: PHRASE("hello world") Expected: Returns documents containing "hello world" in exact sequence
FPH-02: Phrase query with punctuation handling Query: PHRASE("don't", "worry") Expected: Handles apostrophes and punctuation correctly
FPH-03: Multi-word phrase matching Query: PHRASE("the quick brown fox") Expected: Matches exact 4-word sequence
FPH-04: Phrase query case insensitivity Query: PHRASE("Hello World") should match "hello world" Expected: Case-insensitive matching
FPH-05: Phrase with special characters Query: PHRASE("C++ programming") Expected: Correctly handles special characters
FPH-06: Phrase matching with negation Query: !PHRASE("deprecated API") Expected: Returns documents NOT containing the phrase
FPH-07: Phrase combined with other filters Query: PHRASE() AND FILTER u.age > 18 Expected: Combines phrase search with other predicates
FPH-08: Multiple phrase conditions (OR) Query: PHRASE() || PHRASE() Expected: Matches either phrase
FPH-09: Phrase query on specific fields Query: PHRASE(doc.title, ...) vs PHRASE(doc.body, ...) Expected: Field-specific phrase searching
FPH-10: Phrase with stemming/lemmatization Query: PHRASE("running run runs") Expected: Stem variants recognized in phrase
FPH-11: Empty phrase query Query: PHRASE(doc.content, "") Expected: Returns all documents (or error handling)
FPH-12: Single-word phrase Query: PHRASE(doc.content, "single") Expected: Matches single word (equivalent to term search)
FPH-13: Phrase with numbers Query: PHRASE("version 2.0.0") Expected: Correctly handles numeric values in phrases
FPH-14: Phrase query result sorting Query: PHRASE() ... SORT BY relevance DESC Expected: Results sorted by phrase relevance/position
FPH-15: Phrase query with limit Query: PHRASE() LIMIT 10 Expected: Returns top 10 phrase matches
FPH-16: Phrase with wildcards (if supported) Query: PHRASE("term* remaining") Expected: Prefix matching within phrase
FPH-17: Performance test — phrase query latency Expected: ≤100ms on 100K documents
FPH-18: Performance test — phrase throughput Expected: Process ≥100 phrases/second
FPH-19: Phrase index usage verification Expected: Query uses phrase index (if available)
FPH-20: Phrase query error handling Expected: Invalid phrases generate meaningful errors
FPX-01: Basic proximity query Query: PROXIMITY("term1", "term2", distance=5) Expected: Returns documents with terms within 5 words
FPX-02: Proximity with default distance Query: PROXIMITY("term1", "term2") Expected: Uses default distance (e.g., 10 words)
FPX-03: Proximity with zero distance (same as phrase) Query: PROXIMITY("term1", "term2", distance=0) Expected: Matches adjacent terms
FPX-04: Proximity with large distance Query: PROXIMITY("term1", "term2", distance=100) Expected: Matches terms far apart but within limit
FPX-05: Proximity with multiple terms Query: PROXIMITY("term1", "term2", "term3", distance=10) Expected: All terms within 10-word window
FPX-06: Proximity with ordered terms Query: PROXIMITY("first", "second", ordered=true) Expected: Terms must appear in specified order
FPX-07: Proximity with unordered terms Query: PROXIMITY("first", "second", ordered=false) Expected: Terms can appear in any order within distance
FPX-08: Proximity negation Query: !PROXIMITY("term1", "term2") Expected: Returns documents where terms are NOT proximal
FPX-09: Proximity with field scoping Query: PROXIMITY(doc.title, ...) vs PROXIMITY(doc.body, ...) Expected: Proximity search on specific fields
FPX-10: Proximity combined with phrase Query: PHRASE() AND PROXIMITY() Expected: Combines phrase and proximity conditions
FPX-11: Proximity with case handling Query: PROXIMITY("Term1", "term2") Expected: Case-insensitive matching
FPX-12: Proximity with numbers Query: PROXIMITY("version", "2.0") Expected: Handles numeric proximity
FPX-13: Proximity with stemming Query: PROXIMITY("running", "run", distance=5) Expected: Stem variants recognized in proximity
FPX-14: Proximity sorting by distance Query: PROXIMITY() SORT BY _distance ASC Expected: Results sorted by proximity distance
FPX-15: Proximity result projection with distance Query: PROXIMITY() RETURN {doc, distance: _distance} Expected: Include distance metric in results
FPX-16: Performance test — proximity query latency Expected: ≤100ms on 100K documents
FPX-17: Performance test — proximity throughput Expected: Process ≥100 proximity queries/second
FPX-18: Proximity index usage Expected: Query uses proximity index (if available)
FPX-19: Proximity error handling Expected: Invalid proximity syntax generates clear errors
FPX-20: Proximity with very large document set Expected: Maintains ≤100ms latency on 100K+ documents
